Here is a thorough report on the Siril codebase.

---

## 1. What Siril Is

**Siril** is an open-source astronomical image processing application, developed by the **free-astro** team. It is specifically designed for:

- Noise reduction and improving signal-to-noise ratio from multiple captures (a fundamental need in astrophotography)
- Automatic or manual alignment, stacking, and enhancement of astronomical images
- Processing various file formats including FITS, SER, RAW, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, HEIF, JPEG XL, XISF, and video files
- Astrometry solving (plate solving to identify celestial coordinates)
- Photometric color calibration using spectrophotometric data
- Deconvolution, background extraction, and numerous other image filters

The project is licensed under **GPL-3.0-or-later**. The current version is **1.5.0**. It has been published in the Journal of Open Source Software (2024). The project is hosted at `https://gitlab.com/free-astro/siril` with a website at `https://www.siril.org`.

The primary maintainers are Vincent Hourdin, Cyril Richard, and Cecile Melis. The original author (up to v0.8, 2006) was Francois Meyer.

---

## 2. Overall Directory Structure

```
D:\code\siril\
|-- src/                  # Main source code (C/C++)
|-- data/                 # Data files (constellation CSVs, star catalogues, etc.)
|-- docs/                 # Documentation (harmonize_img_t_plan.md)
|-- build/                # Build infrastructure (AppImage, Docker, Flatpak, Windows packaging)
|-- subprojects/          # Third-party library subprojects (htmesh, wcslib, kplot, librtprocess, yyjson, healpix_cxx)
|-- platform-specific/    # Platform-specific code (linux/, macos/, windows/)
|-- po/                   # Translation files (i18n)
|-- python_module/        # Python module "sirilpy" for scripting integration
|-- scripts/              # Bundled processing scripts (.ssf files) + lint script
|-- pixmaps/              # Icons and images
|-- notifications/        # Notification resources
|-- paper/                # Academic paper materials
|-- tools/                # Development tools
|-- 3rdparty_licenses/    # Third-party license files
|-- .gitlab/              # GitLab issue/MR templates
```

Key top-level files:
- `meson.build` (30 KB) - Main build configuration
- `meson_options.txt` - Build options
- `README.md` - Project readme
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` - Contribution guidelines
- `AUTHORS` - Author credits
- `CITATION.cff` - Academic citation info
- `LICENSE.md` - GPL v3 license
- `ChangeLog` - Project changelog
- `.gitlab-ci.yml` - CI/CD pipeline
- `siril.1` - Man page
- `siril.doxyfile` - Doxygen config
- `.editorconfig` - Code style config (tabs for C/H, 2-space for build/UI files)

There is **no CLAUDE.md** file in this repository.

---

## 3. Build System

Siril uses the **Meson** build system with **Ninja** as the backend. Key build details from `meson.build`:

- **Languages**: C (gnu11 standard) and C++ (c++17 standard)
- **Minimum Meson version**: 0.56.0
- **Default build type**: `debugoptimized`
- **Build commands**: `meson setup --prefix /usr/local --buildtype release _build && ninja -C _build`

The build produces two executables:
1. **`siril`** - Full GUI application (GTK4-based), only built when `-Dgtk=true` (default)
2. **`siril-cli`** - Headless command-line-only binary, always built

Build architecture:
- `siril_lib` - Core static library (non-GUI, compiled against `core_dep` which has no GTK)
- `siril_headless_lib` - Stub implementations for GUI functions (used by CLI)
- The GUI executable links `siril_lib` plus GUI source files; the CLI links `siril_lib` plus headless stubs

There are 20+ optional dependencies controlled by meson options (see `meson_options.txt`), including OpenMP, exiv2, libraw, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, HEIF, XISF, JPEG XL, ffms2, ffmpeg, libcurl, SQLite, libgit2, and criterion (testing).

The build supports **Linux, Windows (MSYS2/MinGW), macOS, and BSD**. Platform-specific handling includes Flatpak, AppImage, and Docker builds under `build/`.

---

## 4. Key Source Directories

The `src/` directory (`D:\code\siril\src\`) contains **561 source files** (`.c`, `.cpp`, `.h`) totaling approximately **155,000 lines of code**. Here is what each subdirectory contains:

### `src/core/` - Core infrastructure (~70 files)
The heart of the application. Key files:
- `siril.h` / `siril.c` - Main data structures and global state
- `command.c` (519 KB!) - Command processing engine (massive file handling all scripting commands)
- `command_def.h` (122 KB) - Command definitions and help text
- `command_list.h` - Command list/registry
- `processing.c` / `processing_thread.c` - Multi-threaded processing framework
- `settings.c` / `settings.h` - Application settings/preferences
- `icc_profile.c` - ICC color management
- `masks.c` - Mask/selection system
- `undo.c` - Undo/redo system
- `arithm.c` - Arithmetic operations on images
- `preprocess.c` - Image preprocessing (calibration frames)
- `pipe.c` - Named pipe interface for external control
- `gui_iface.h` / `gui_iface_stubs.c` / `headless_stubs.c` - GUI abstraction layer (allows core to work with or without GTK)
- `OS_utils.c` - Platform-specific utilities
- `siril_networking.c` / `siril_update.c` - Network and update checking

### `src/algos/` - Algorithms (~65 files)
Scientific and image processing algorithms:
- `astrometry_solver.c` (88 KB) - Plate solving / astrometric calibration
- `background_extraction.c` (86 KB) - Gradient/background removal
- `star_finder.c` (58 KB) - Star detection
- `photometric_cc.c` / `spcc.c` - Photometric and spectrophotometric color calibration
- `photometry.c` - Aperture photometry
- `PSF.c` - Point Spread Function fitting
- `statistics.c` / `statistics_float.c` - Image statistics
- `colors.c` - Color space conversions
- `demosaicing.c` / `demosaicing_rtp.cpp` / `demosaicing_siril.c` - Bayer pattern demosaicing
- `geometry.c` (52 KB) - Geometric transformations (rotation, binning, resample)
- `extraction.c` - Channel extraction
- `median_fast.c` (228 KB) - Optimized median computation
- `noise.c` - Noise estimation
- `quality.c` - Image quality assessment
- `siril_wcs.c` - World Coordinate System handling
- `search_objects.c` - Celestial object search
- `comparison_stars.c` - Comparison star selection for photometry
- `lcms_acceleration/` - SIMD-accelerated color management transforms

### `src/io/` - Input/Output (~60 files)
File format handling and data I/O:
- `image_format_fits.c` (128 KB) - FITS file reading/writing (the primary format)
- `image_formats_libraries.c` (108 KB) - TIFF, JPEG, PNG, HEIF, etc. via external libraries
- `image_formats_internal.c` (33 KB) - Internal format support (BMP, PPM, etc.)
- `ser.c` (48 KB) - SER video format (astronomy-specific)
- `sequence.c` (91 KB) - Image sequence management
- `conversion.c` (56 KB) - Format conversion
- `siril_catalogues.c` (59 KB) - Star catalogue access
- `remote_catalogues.c` / `local_catalogues.c` - Online/offline catalogue querying
- `annotation_catalogues.c` - Object annotation data
- `siril_pythonmodule.c` (131 KB) / `siril_pythoncommands.c` (141 KB) - Python scripting integration
- `siril_plot.c` - Plotting/charting (Cairo-based)
- `siril_git.c` (43 KB) - Git integration for script repository sync
- `fits_keywords.c` (67 KB) - FITS header keyword management
- `mp4_output.c` - Video export
- `SirilJpegXLWrapper.cpp` / `SirilXISFReader.cpp` - C++ wrappers for JXL and XISF
- `healpix/` - HEALPix sky tessellation (for Gaia data)
- `avi_pipp/` - AVI writing library (from PIPP project)
- `kstars/` - KStars/HTMesh integration

### `src/gui-gtk4/` - GTK4 GUI (~85+ files, 75 UI XML files)
The graphical user interface (GTK4):
- `callbacks.c` (153 KB) - Main UI callback handlers
- `image_display.c` (190 KB) - Image rendering and display
- `image_interactions.c` (48 KB) - Mouse/keyboard interaction with images
- `histogram.c` (83 KB) - Histogram manipulation dialogs
- `file_browser.c` (170 KB) - Custom file browser with FITS preview
- `compositing.c` (96 KB) - RGB compositing UI
- `registration.c` (90 KB) - Registration dialog
- `python_gui.c` (139 KB) - Python script editor/manager
- `preferences.c` (59 KB) - Preferences dialog
- `plot.c` (88 KB) - Light curve and data plotting
- `curves.c` (41 KB) - Curves adjustment tool
- `siril_actions.c` - GAction definitions
- `siril.css` (25 KB) - Application stylesheet
- `uifiles/` - 75 `.ui` XML files defining dialog layouts

### `src/filters/` - Image Filters (~40 files)
Image processing filters:
- `deconvolution.c` / `deconvolution/` - Deconvolution algorithms (Richardson-Lucy, Wiener, etc.)
- `ght.c` (44 KB) - Generalized Hyperbolic Transforms (stretch)
- `mtf.c` - Midtone Transfer Function
- `synthstar.c` (29 KB) - Synthetic star generation
- `fft.c` - FFT-based filtering
- `median.c` - Median filtering
- `wavelets.c` - Wavelet transforms
- `asinh.c` - Asinh stretch
- `banding.c` - Banding removal
- `cosmetic_correction.c` - Hot/cold pixel correction
- `epf.c` - Edge-preserving filter
- `scnr.c` - Subtractive Chromatic Noise Reduction
- `unpurple.c` - Purple fringe removal
- `nlbayes/` - Non-local Bayesian denoising
- `da3d/` - DA3D denoising

### `src/registration/` - Image Registration (~15 files + subfolders)
Image alignment/registration:
- `global.c` (50 KB) - Global star-based registration
- `applyreg.c` (60 KB) - Apply registration transformations
- `mpp.cpp` (108 KB) - Multi-Point Processing registration (a major feature)
- `mpp/` - MPP sub-modules (run, config, frames, rank, align, shift, stack, sidecar)
- `astrometric.c` - Astrometric registration
- `comet.c` - Comet tracking registration
- `distorsion.c` - Distortion correction
- `3stars.c` - Three-star manual registration
- `matching/` - Star matching algorithms (pattern matching, triangle matching)

### `src/stacking/` - Image Stacking (~15 files)
Combining multiple aligned images:
- `stacking.c` (25 KB) - Main stacking orchestration
- `median_and_mean.c` (69 KB) - Median and mean stacking methods
- `normalization.c` (34 KB) - Frame normalization before stacking
- `rejection_float.c` - Pixel rejection algorithms (sigma clipping, etc.)
- `sum.c` - Summation stacking
- `stackminmax.c` - Min/max stacking
- `upscaling.c` - Drizzle-like upscaling
- `stack_mpp.c` - MPP-specific stacking
- `blending.c` - Blending methods

### Other `src/` subdirectories:
- **`src/opencv/`** - OpenCV C++ wrappers (`opencv.cpp` 54 KB, `guidedfilter.cpp`, `kombat/` - KOMBAT algorithm)
- **`src/pixelMath/`** - Pixel math expression engine (`pixel_math_runner.c`, `tinyexpr.c` - expression parser)
- **`src/compositing/`** - RGB channel alignment and compositing filters
- **`src/drizzle/`** - Drizzle algorithm (sub-pixel stacking) ported from STScI
- **`src/livestacking/`** - Live stacking for real-time capture
- **`src/rt/`** - RawTherapee-derived algorithms (box blur, Gaussian, SIMD helpers)
- **`src/tests/`** - Unit tests (criterion-based, ~27 test files covering MPP, sorting, photometry, SER, stacking, etc.)

### `python_module/sirilpy/` - Python API
A Python package providing scripting integration:
- `connection.py` - Communication with Siril process
- `models.py` - Data models
- `enums.py` - Enumeration types
- `plot.py` - Plotting utilities
- `shm.py` - Shared memory for image data
- `gpuhelper.py` - GPU acceleration helpers

---

## 5. Programming Languages

- **Primary language: C** (gnu11 standard) - The vast majority of source code
- **Secondary language: C++** (C++17 standard) - Used for OpenCV wrappers, deconvolution algorithms, denoising (NL-Bayes, DA3D), MPP registration, XISF/JXL file format wrappers, and some RawTherapee-derived code
- **Python** - Scripting module (`sirilpy`) and test generation
- **XML** - GTK4 UI definition files (75 `.ui` files)
- **CSS** - GTK4 application styling
- **Meson/CMake** - Build system files

The code formatting convention is **K&R style** with **tab indentation** for C/H files.

---

## 6. CLAUDE.md / CONTRIBUTING

- **No CLAUDE.md** exists in this repository.
- **CONTRIBUTING.md** (`D:\code\siril\CONTRIBUTING.md`) covers:
  - Ways to contribute: features, bug reports, testing, docs, translations, donations
  - Links to CI builds for all platforms (Linux AppImage, Windows, macOS ARM/x86)
  - Bug reporting via GitLab issues
  - Code formatting: K&R style
  - Command help formatting: bold argument names, quoted string values, no trailing period
  - Translation via Weblate at `https://weblate.siril.org`
  - Contributor guidelines at `https://siril-contrib-doc.readthedocs.io`

---

## 7. Recent Git Activity (Last ~40 Commits, June-July 2026)

The repository is actively developed. Key areas of recent work:

**Security & Build (July 12)**
- Security fixes merged
- OpenCV 5 build support added

**File I/O & Dialogs (July 7-11)**
- PNG save time optimization
- Save dialog fixes (restoring non-native dialog behavior)
- Open dialog preview improvements
- AVI sequence crash fix
- TIFF 32-bit thumbnail support

**Multi-Point Processing / MPP (July 7)**
- Limb artifact elimination in multipoint stacking (a planetary imaging feature)
- AP (Alignment Point) placement fixes

**GUI & GTK4 (July 2-8)**
- GTK4 issue fixes
- Fit-to-window zoom dispatched to GTK main thread
- Worker-thread gui_iface calls dispatched to GTK main thread (thread safety)
- Cursor grab hardening

**File Browser (June 30 - July 6)**
- FITS metadata display in open file dialog
- File browser improvements and regression fixes
- FITS thumbnail speed improvements

**New Features (July 7)**
- New gradient tool added

**Infrastructure (June 30)**
- Headless CLI Docker image CI job added

**Translations**
- Japanese and French translation updates via Weblate

The most active areas of development are: **file browser/dialog improvements**, **MPP (multi-point processing) for planetary imaging**, **GTK4 thread safety**, and **file format I/O optimizations**.

## 5. Programming Languages

- **Primary language: C** (gnu11 standard) - The vast majority of source code
- **Secondary language: C++** (C++17 standard) - Used for OpenCV wrappers, deconvolution algorithms, denoising (NL-Bayes, DA3D), MPP registration, XISF/JXL file format wrappers, and some RawTherapee-derived code
- **Python** - Scripting module (`sirilpy`) and test generation
- **XML** - GTK4 UI definition files (75 `.ui` files)
- **CSS** - GTK4 application styling
- **Meson/CMake** - Build system files

The code formatting convention is **K&R style** with **tab indentation** for C/H files.
